heading_en: Market Risk Equivalent Amount Based on the Sensitivities-Based Method
summary_ja: リスク感応度方式に基づくマーケット・リスク相当額が、デルタ、ベガ、カーベチャーの各リスクに対する額の合計であることを定める。
summary_en: Defines the market risk equivalent amount under the sensitivities-based method as the sum of the amounts for delta risk, vega risk and curvature risk.
paragraphs: The market risk equivalent amount based on the sensitivities-based method means the sum of the market risk equivalent amounts for delta risk, vega risk and curvature risk.
